Frequently asked questions
How do I invite friends?
After logging in to Qoder, click the "Copy Invite Link and Earn Credits" button on the activity page to copy your exclusive invite link, or click the "Generate Exclusive Invite Poster" button to create an invite poster and share it with your friends. When a friend registers through your exclusive link and completes their first paid subscription within 30 days of registration, both you and your friend will receive Credits rewards.
When will the Credits from the Invite Friends subscription bonus campaign be credited?
If the invited new user completes their first paid subscription within 30 days of registration, the reward will be credited 14 days after the subscription. If there is a delay, please be patient.
My friend is already registered. Can they still join the Invite Friends subscription bonus campaign?
The invitee must be a new user who has never registered before. They can only receive the invitee reward by registering through your exclusive link and completing their first paid subscription within 30 days of registration. Registered users can act as inviters — invite new friends to register and pay, and earn the inviter reward.
How long are the Credits from the Invite Friends subscription bonus campaign valid?
They are valid for 30 days from the date of issuance. Any unused Credits will be automatically cleared after that.
How long is the Invite Friends subscription bonus campaign valid?
The campaign is valid throughout its duration. If the campaign is taken offline, users will be notified in advance. After the campaign ends, the campaign page will go offline, but already-bound referral relationships and rewards already earned will not be affected.
